notes: The stock card has four frames per part: <name> (available), <name>_progress, <name>_complete and the mask <name>_m. The game builds <pkg>.rnd_part_image.<upgrade_name>[_progress|_complete] and <pkg>.rnd_part_mask.<upgrade_name>_m; the plain (non om_xm) lists use _in_progress and an unsuffixed mask.

Every frame is one slice of a texture array: append the slice to the .texarray.image pixels, bump the slice count in the image head (offset 28) and the SRV view (offset 0x14), and clone an overrides.uidb entry with Name = frame, Value = source_tif, as tools/build_icons.py does.
